name: The Escape
objectiveText: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.   Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site  ( 1 )

objectiveRows.text: Escort Wizzlecrank out of the Venture Co. drill site

comments.body:
U have to return to ratchet to get the reward.
Look for sputtervalve

Easy escort quest. Make it easier and quicker by clearing out the guys to the West of the shredder so he has to stop less.

After you make it to the top of the ramp, you'll get attacked by two more Venture Company guys. They're no harder than the other ones you just fought, so they should go down quickly.

The quest gets turned in at Ratchet, so don't be alarmed when he disappears after you're done.
Complete "The Escape" quest by going to Ratchet and talk to Sputtervalve
It can't be. I'm a Dwarf Paladin, and I was able to get this quest and complete it within the past 12 hours.
The hand in is at Ratchet.
replies: Thottbot does tell you that ... when you click on the "Ends at", it says Sputtervalve, which is in Ratchet.

I don't know what happened but it sure wasn't what had happened in the past.  I'm about to reattempt it now, so, be weary of that
I Can't Find the Second Shredder is it in Rachet or Where is  it

I thought you had to take him all the way back to ratchet, but you only have to kill the guys and take him up the bank to the west. If you haven't been having trouble with the guards so far, then this should be easy with the shredder to help you.

Although Wizzlecrank would ask you to hurry and talk to Sputtervalve, I don't think there really is any urgency (i.e. a time limit). I didn't realise that until too late. I was doing the Nugget Slugs quest at the same time. So instead of running back to Rachet right away, I should have turned in the Nugget Slugs quest to Wenikee Boltbucket first, then on to Orgrimmer to turn in the follow up quest Rilli Greasygob, and then back to Rachet to turn in this quest. I did not plan to do the follow up quest of Rilli Greasygob, Samophlange Manual. But if you do, finish it before returning to Rachet.

Hope this will help you save some time on unnecessary travels.
I escorted him out and it said completed, but I cant get my reward?  They both vanished, which tells me I completed the quest.  Any idea why I cant collect my reward?  Have I missed something?
replies: You have to go back to Ratchet and speak to Sputtervalve again.

comments.body: Like the "Ignition" quest leading up to it, this quest is available to both Alliance and Horde characters.
The best bet in doing this quest is to go in as a group. its about the only way you can clear a path and protect him through the mission.
